lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the branchial region, with 6-8 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a distinct grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extending longitudinally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae (remora) specimens are visible in the lower right quadrant, positioned near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
